rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=19, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1100, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_2017 iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: epochs 14 -> 19 (max that fits the HARD 1200s train+score budget at OOM-safe batch_size=2). BASE_ITER=2 (the BEST valid config, SSIM 0.8012, vn_lambda_init=0.0023) -- reverting AWAY from iter-3 (lambda 0.05, regressed to 0.7932) and iter-4 (n_filters 4, regressed to 0.7828); both single-knob moves regressed, so iter-5 restarts from the best point and changes a different axis. TRAJECTORY (corrected metric, all hr=0, all BELOW the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor): iter-1 OOM (bs=4, no recon); iter-2 SSIM 0.8012 (FIRST valid, ep14/bs2/lambda0.0023, train_time 789.7s); iter-3 0.7932 (lambda 0.0023->0.05 REGRESSED); iter-4 0.7828 (n_filters 16->4 REGRESSED). LIMITER = UNDER-TRAINING, not capacity/lambda/data. EVIDENCE: the corrected-metric runs use bs=2/ep14 = 1400 grad steps; the (now-discarded boundary-slice-metric) sibling sweep CONVERGED only at bs=1/ep38 = 7600 steps (SSIM 8->38 epochs climbed 0.876->0.9484). bs=2/ep14 is ~5x under-trained on gradient steps, and the corrected runs finished ep14 in only 789.7s train -- ~400s of the 1200s budget left UNSPENT. iter-3 claimed epochs-up was INERT because the LOSS converged (8.7e-7 by ep5), but loss-convergence != SSIM-convergence for this VN (the old sweep kept lifting SSIM to ep38 long after loss was tiny). DATA-COVERAGE lever DEFERRED: mechanism verified live (solver loads a FIXED train_n subset via load_val_split + torch.randperm, NO RotatingSubset, so train_n IS a coverage lever), BUT (a) the old-metric train_n 200->300 probe was FLAT (0.9484->0.9478 = the tiny 0.018M VN was NOT data-limited), and (b) per the campaign rule data-coverage applies only AFTER the epoch/capacity levers plateau -- they have NOT (corrected runs are stuck at ep14, far below the proven ep38 convergence point). So epochs FIRST. BUDGET: train_time 56.4s/epoch (789.7s/14); 19 epochs = ~1072s train + ~90s score(214) = ~1162s < 1200s budget; max_train_s=1100 backstop trips before the figure, well under the 1800s SLURM kill. MEMORY-SAFE: identical footprint to iter-2 (bs=2, N_k=16, 31-bump RBF across 5 unrolled steps within 16 GB -- do NOT raise bs, bs=4 OOMed iter-1). grad_clip=1.0 retained (VN-family NaN-skip). HYPOTHESIS: with ~36 percent more gradient steps (1400->1900) the under-trained VN climbs toward its proven convergence basin; predict val_ssim 0.80 -> ~0.86 (clears the 0.84 FBP floor, hr > 0). FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays <= 0.84 (still below FBP) at 19 epochs, the bs=2 optimization basin is genuinely worse than the bs=1 ep38 path and the budget cannot reach convergence with bs=2 -- iter-6 must then lower lr to extend the effective training (or document the budget-bounded ceiling). lr=5e-4 held (campaign record: lr5e-4 optimal for VN family, 8e-4 worse).
